hotspots.title: Judge Blocks Trump Media Ban
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges issued and extended orders preventing the Trump administration from banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters from the White House, framing the move as a defense of press freedom against executive overreach.
hotspots.affect: Repeated coverage emphasizes a battle over free speech, casting the administration as authoritarian and the judiciary as a bulwark, intensifying partisan charge.
